# BOTANICA (02 · botanica)

A perfumery whose garden grows down the page — generative SVG vines drawn by your scroll.

- **Technique:** SCROLL-GROWN SVG
- **Tags:** organic, natural, light, botanical, illustrated, scroll, soft, beauty
- **Best for:** beauty & skincare; perfume; florists; wellness brands
- **Fonts:** Fraunces, Karla
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;1,9..144,300;1,9..144,400&family=Karla:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #f2ecdd · #3c4d34 · #c4694a
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/botanica/` (Template.astro, content.ts, meta.ts, pollen.ts, style.css, theme.css, vine.ts)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css
/* botanica — design tokens. Override any of these per site via `theme` (inline on <html>). */
:root {
  --paper: #f2ecdd;
  --paper2: #eae2cd;
  --paper3: #e0d6bc;
  --ink: #2e3a2a;
  --ink-soft: #57614d;
  --ink-faint: #8a9179;
  --moss: #3c4d34;
  --leaf: #57724a;
  --root: #8a6b3f;
  --terra: #c4694a;
  --terra-soft: #d99b7c;
  --gold: #b08d3f;
  --sand: #c9bd9d;

  /* perfume bottles */
  --glass-hi: #ffffff;
  --glass-shade: #5c5c50;
  --glass-body: #eef0e4;
  --label-paper: #f7f3e6;
  --bottle-verte-liquid: #7d9463;
  --bottle-verte-cap: var(--moss);
  --bottle-mai-liquid: var(--terra-soft);
  --bottle-mai-cap: #8a5a40;
  --bottle-pluie-liquid: #9db4ab;
  --bottle-pluie-cap: #465a52;

  --serif: "Fraunces", serif;
  --sans: "Karla", sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
}
```

## Signature effects
- `pollen.ts`
  - `initPollen(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement)` — Slow drifting pollen motes over the whole viewport. Removed entirely under reduced motion.
- `vine.ts`
  - `initVine(rail: HTMLElement)` — A seeded, meandering vine in a fixed side rail. Its stem draws itself with page scroll and leaves/blossoms pop out as the stem passes their node. Colors come from the palette tokens.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<br>/<a>/<span> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Botanical icon drawn above a note. */
export type GlyphId = 'citrus' | 'rose' | 'root';

/** Bottle colorway; maps to the `--bottle-<id>-*` tokens in theme.css. */
export type BottleId = 'verte' | 'mai' | 'pluie';

export interface Note {
  /** Pill in the card's top-right corner, e.g. "Top · 0–15 min". */
  stage: string;
  glyph: GlyphId;
  name: string;
  /** Italic Latin name. */
  latin: string;
  text: string;
}

export interface Bottle {
  variant: BottleId;
  name: string;
  /** Printed on the bottle label (upper case). */
  label: string;
  /** Italic note list under the name. */
  notes: string;
  price: string;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Brand wordmark in the nav and footer; the <span> is tinted terracotta. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  /** Section anchors available: #notes, #collection, #story, #almanac. Nav is hidden below 900px. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Small caps line above the headline. */
    est: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    sub: string;
    cta: Link;
    /** Cue shown at the bottom of the hero (hidden below 760px). */
    scrollLabel: string;
  };
  notes: { kicker: string; headingHtml: string; items: Note[] };
  /** Brand printed on every bottle label. */
  labelBrand: string;
  collection: { kicker: string; headingHtml: string; bottles: Bottle[] };
  story: { kicker: string; quoteHtml: string; cite: string };
  almanac: {
    kicker: string;
    headingHtml: string;
    rows: { month: string; title: string; text: string }[];
  };
  footer: { addressHtml: string; creditHtml: string };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered only when the Template receives `showcase`. */
  showcase?: { chipLabel: string; chipHref: string; footerHtml: string };
}
```

- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style botanica --out <dir>`
